title: Goods Receiving field configuration
description: Single source of truth for every field of a receiving record. Read by the web part (form, table, filters, export) and by the provisioning script (SharePoint columns).

sections.description: Groups of fields on the form and detail view, in display order.

key.description: Stable identifier used by the app. camelCase, never change it after go-live.

internalName.description: SharePoint internal column name. Letters and digits only, no spaces. Never change it after the column was created.

displayName.description: Label shown to users and used as the Excel column header.

type.description: Text = single line, Note = multiple lines, Date = date only, DateTime = date and time, User = person, Lookup = reference to another list.

description.description: Help text shown under the field in the form.

required.description: Required when the record is submitted for approval.

requiredForDraft.description: Also required when saving a draft. These columns are also marked required in SharePoint.

requiredWhen.description: Makes the field required when another field has one of the listed values.

builtIn.description: A column SharePoint already has (Title, Author, Created, Editor, Modified). Not created by the provisioning script.

readOnly.description: Not editable in the form (set by the app or by SharePoint).

defaultValue.description: Initial value for new records. Use [today] for dates and [me] for person fields.

badgeTones.description: Shows the value as a coloured badge. Map each choice to a tone.

decimals.description: Number of decimal places for Number fields.

minExclusive.description: Value must be greater than this number.

maxExclusive.description: Value must be less than this number.

pattern.description: Regular expression the value must match.

lookup.description: For Lookup fields: the list to look up and the column to show.

indexed.description: Create a SharePoint index (needed for fast filtering above 5,000 items). Max 20 per list.

order.description: Display order in the form, table, detail view and export.

section.description: Key of the section the field belongs to.

showInForm.description: Show in the new/edit form (default true unless readOnly or builtIn).

showInDetail.description: Show in the record detail view (default true).

filterable.description: Offer a filter for this field in the record list.

searchable.description: Include in the free-text search. Text fields only.

tableWidth.description: Column width in pixels in the record list.
